capabilities: Interview the user about a project one question at a time via Claude Code
File answers as linked markdown notes with charter, open questions, and ideas sections
Display the project as a clickable, foldable mindmap tree with heat and radial layouts
Track open questions and ideas to explore on each note
Enforce file-access limits with Allow/Deny prompts for out-of-scope actions
disambiguation: Not an AI writing assistant; it records and organizes what you tell it and won't write prose for you.
extras: The interviewer edits notes directly with no undo, so the README warns to keep the vault under git or backup. Runs the claude executable as a child process and reads the whole vault, which Obsidian's plugin review flags; the README explains each flagged behavior. Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13+, no mobile). Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to build up a project by talking it through, with an assistant that records your answers as structured, linked notes instead of writing content for you.

relations.evidence: The plugin is a front end for Claude Code

requires.name: Paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise) or Anthropic Console account

summary: Conversational interviewer that asks about your project one question at a time, files answers as linked markdown notes, and shows the project as a live mindmap.
